description: List contacts in the workspace, optionally filtered by external ids or sources. Returns each contact's default fields (name, company, emails, phone numbers) and custom fields. OpenPhone REST: GET /contacts.

externalIds.description: Filter to contacts with these external ids (from an integrated system).

pageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response's nextPageToken.

sources.description: Filter to contacts created by these sources.

name: openphone_list_contacts
title: List contacts
